title: Tamura urges a faster move toward neutral policy
summary: A 26 November speech argues for prompt adjustment toward neutral. This is a BOJ member's assessment, not a new policy decision or mortgage quote.

takeaways.text: A member's preferred policy pace does not determine your mortgage reset date.

sections.heading: The new statement
sections.text: In Yamanashi on 26 November, Naoki Tamura argues that financial conditions remain accommodative and policy should reach neutral promptly. He says a few months after a hike can provide enough evidence to assess conditions; upside inflation risks could require faster tightening. These are his views, not a new Board decision.

sections.heading: Borrower interpretation
sections.text: Our interpretation: review repayment sensitivity without assuming a specific rate path. For JPY variable loans, confirm contractual rate and payment reviews; for initial fixed periods, obtain subsequent pricing; for full-term fixed loans, confirm funding-month terms. This speech establishes no bank offer, eligibility, fees or promotion.

sections.heading: Dates and limits
sections.text: Speech, publication and report date: 26 November 2026, Asia/Tokyo. The UTC check is separate below. No offer-validity period applies; a separate webpage-update date is unknown.
